text: [Example] What is the difference between a clustered and a non clustered index?
answerOutline: A clustered index defines the physical order of rows. A non clustered index is a separate structure that points to the rows.

text: [Example] Why is a stack a good fit for checking balanced brackets?
answerOutline: Push each opening bracket. On a closing bracket, pop and compare. The string is balanced if the stack ends empty.
